name: Algebra 1 Notes Course Profile
role: Course-specific Algebra Notes behavior. The Notes PM owns build procedure/packaging; this profile owns Algebra-specific instructional rhythm, routine defaults, visual behavior, and course conventions.

instructional_spine.primary: Current section Intro Learning Target and exact I Can statements from the current Assessment Plan.
instructional_spine.language: Use simple concrete high-school Algebra language. Prefer input/output and ordered-pair language where useful; use f(x) naturally.
instructional_spine.teacher_choice_principle: Build a complete ready-to-use toolbox, but the teacher is not expected to use every included component every time.

required_in_normal_build: Core reading organized by exact I Can
Common Mistakes to Watch as final visible section
selective_by_section: Talk to the Text / Close Reading
standard_section_components.skip_rule: Included routines must be modular enough that skipping one does not make later reading nonsensical.

why_it_matters.rule: Explain why the mathematics is useful, foundational, or worth noticing. Do not invent fake career relevance.

purpose: preview a useful representation or pattern
connect to a prerequisite without teaching the whole section early
lets_get_started.size: one prompt or tiny coherent set
lets_get_started.visual_preference: Prefer a visual, table, pattern, or diagram when natural.
not_allowed: an EX/YTI pair disguised as an opener

wtc.source: Current completed Unit Bank canonical WTC
rules: Preserve item ID, prompt, representation, I Can identity, and answer/solution lineage.
Do not silently rewrite or simplify.
Teacher copy may add instructional/discourse support.
Student copy must not leak the answer.

example_yti.source_model: Purpose-author/refine during Notes build from exact I Can -> accepted map evidence job/representation route -> Question Structure -> Practice1 calibration when useful -> fresh Notes-specific instance.
example_yti.second_pair_policy: A second pair is allowed only when the I Can has a materially different second learning job that cannot be represented well by the first pair.
earned_second_pair_reasons: two different procedures or decision paths
high-value misconception requiring a separate corrective instance

exit_firewall.scope: All generated Notes question/tasks, including Let's Get Started, EX/YTI, and question-like discussion prompts.
prohibited_overlap: same or trivially changed wording preserving the Exit's distinctive task sequence
same distinctive representation with cosmetic changes only
near-parallel rehearsal that effectively gives away the Exit task

math_notes.default: Each I Can should include one meaningful visual anchor in or immediately beside Math Notes when the mathematics supports one.
preferred_visuals: annotated expression/equation with labels or arrows
mini table tied to an equation or graph
math_notes.paragraph_only_rule: Allowed only when a visual would be artificial or less clear.
math_notes.visual_rule: Every visual must teach, organize, compare, or make structure visible; decorative visuals do not count.
math_notes.graph_rule: Use the registered Algebra graph tool for new coordinate/function graphs; do not hand-build coordinate SVG.

vocabulary_preview.use_when: Vocabulary or notation load makes prior-knowledge sorting useful.

talk_to_text.use_when: Reading or visual density makes annotation worthwhile.

stop_and_discuss.use_when: Student talk materially improves interpretation, comparison, reasoning, critique, or misconception repair.

section_close.common_mistakes_rule: Common Mistakes to Watch is the final visible section.
section_close.notes_exit_check: Do not add a Notes Exit Check.

generated_task_metadata: exact I Can text resolvable in artifact

required_checks: exact Learning Target and I Can alignment
standard section components present unless explicitly omitted by teacher
default one EX/YTI pair per exact I Can
all generated Notes tasks pass Exit firewall
visual-first Math Notes used where mathematics supports one
Common Mistakes present and final visible section
no page-level or inline layout/color CSS
source_map copied unchanged into Notes provenance
